explication: V2RayAggregator collects public proxy subscriptions and free-airport subscriptions, converts and validates their nodes, then tests and ranks them before publishing mixed, Base64, and Clash outputs. Public-node and airport processing are separate branches. README documents the overall speed-filtering workflow and output formats; sampled code confirms key collection, conversion, and output operations, but does not expose the full speed-test orchestration, so that connection is documented rather than inferred from unsampled workflow files.
